project_summary: Implementation of Google OAuth sign-in, token-based email password reset mechanism with mobile web fix, and secure JWT-based session management with 7-day inactivity expiration.
identified_risks: Email delivery failures or delayed token delivery for password resets on mobile devices.
Potential session token hijacking or improper handling during OAuth callback handling.
Inconsistent behavior of HttpOnly cookie handling across cross-domain environments or mobile browsers.

user_stories.title: Google OAuth Sign-In Integration
user_stories.user_story: As an enterprise user, I want to sign in using my Google account, so that I can quickly onboard and access the application without manually creating credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is on the login page, When they click 'Sign in with Google', Then they are redirected to the Google authentication consent screen.
Given a user completes Google authentication, When they are redirected back, Then a secure session is initiated and they are redirected to the dashboard.

user_stories.title: Token-Based Password Reset via Email
user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to receive a secure token-based password reset link via email, so that I can safely reset my password on mobile web views and desktop.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, When they submit their email, Then a secure token link is emailed to them.
Given a user opens the reset link on a mobile web view or desktop, When they enter a valid new password, Then the password is updated and the reset token is invalidated.

user_stories.title: Secure JWT Storage and Session Inactivity Handling
user_stories.user_story: As a security engineer, I want JWT tokens stored in HttpOnly cookies and set to expire after 7 days of inactivity, so that user sessions are kept secure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user authenticates, When the session starts, Then the JWT is stored inside an HttpOnly, Secure cookie.
Given a user has been inactive for 7 consecutive days, When they make an API request, Then the session is invalidated and the user is redirected to log in.
